  • Enterprise agent adoption is running ahead of operating readiness — New analysis suggests companies want agentic workflows quickly, but most lack the process, governance, and infrastructure to support them.
  • Entry-level work becomes the hidden labor fault line — Fresh reporting argues AI may not crush headline employment yet, but it is likely weakening the bottom rung of knowledge-work career ladders.
  • OpenAI expands publisher strategy in Brazil — Partnerships with Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL extend ChatGPT’s access to licensed news and reinforce the platform’s regional content strategy.
  • Google’s AI security posture remains in transition — Even the largest AI operators are still figuring out practical security controls, highlighting how immature the field remains under real deployment pressure.
  • AI governance pressure broadens beyond tech policy circles — The pope’s AI encyclical and renewed debate over autonomous warfare show concerns about concentrated power and weaponization moving deeper into mainstream institutions.
